skill.name: tophub-defou-stanley-combo
skill.description: Fetches TopHub trends, selects promising topics, and generates Simplified Chinese Defou x Stanley content drafts.
skill.summary: Generates structured Chinese content drafts from current TopHub trends.
skill.author: wangdefou-dev

security_audit.summary: I reviewed the TypeScript workflow, Markdown instructions, and bundled evaluation file. Most static hits are false positives from JavaScript template literals, Markdown backticks, expected network access, local configuration, and bounded output writes. I found context-level risks from a self-audit safety claim and untrusted trend text entering LLM prompts.

remediation.suggestion: Remove EVALUATION.json from the published skill, or label it clearly as non-authoritative test data.

remediation.issue: Fetched trend text is inserted into LLM prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Wrap trend titles and sources in clear data delimiters, and tell the model to ignore instructions inside them.

remediation.issue: API endpoint configuration can affect where credentials are sent.
remediation.suggestion: Document ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL use and validate allowed hosts before sending an API key.

remediation.issue: The workflow logs the .env file path.
remediation.suggestion: Log only whether required configuration is present, not the full environment file path.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Injection Attempt Detected
semantic_findings.description: EVALUATION.json includes "safe_to_publish": true and says all static findings are false positives. This untrusted self-audit can bias marketplace review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly presents a safety verdict and broad dismissal of findings. It does not issue an override command, so confidence is high but not maximal.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Trend Text Enters LLM Prompts
semantic_findings.description: TopHub titles and source labels are inserted directly into LLM prompts. A malicious trend title could steer topic selection or output format.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow from scraped topic fields into prompt text and model calls is explicit. I found no delimiter or instruction that treats fetched text as untrusted data.

content.value_statement: Trend tracking and long-form drafting take time for content teams. This skill fetches TopHub topics and produces structured Simplified Chinese drafts in three Defou x Stanley styles.
actual_capabilities: Fetches the TopHub hot list from https://tophub.today/hot.
Parses topic titles, ranks, sources, heat labels, and links.
Asks Anthropic Claude to select ten high-potential topics.
Generates Stanley, Defou, and combined article versions for each topic.
Supports mock mode through MOCK_MODE for local testing.
limitations: Requires network access to TopHub and the Anthropic API.
Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unless MOCK_MODE is true.
Generated writing is Simplified Chinese and needs editorial review.
Topic selection depends on TopHub page structure and availability.

use_cases.title: Draft trend commentary
use_cases.description: Use fresh TopHub topics to create Chinese opinion drafts for review and editing.

use_cases.title: Plan daily posts
use_cases.description: Turn current hot topics into multiple draft angles for daily social channels.

use_cases.title: Compare content angles
use_cases.description: Review Stanley, Defou, and combined versions before choosing a publication direction.

prompt_templates.title: Run the workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use tophub-defou-stanley-combo to fetch current TopHub topics and generate Markdown drafts.

prompt_templates.title: Test without API spend
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the workflow with MOCK_MODE=true and show where the draft files would be saved.

prompt_templates.title: Review generated drafts
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the skill, then summarize the selected topics, source links, and draft file paths for review.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt topic selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Modify the workflow to select only career and psychology topics, then generate the three content variants for each topic.

output_examples.input: Fetch trends and generate drafts for today.
output: The skill fetches the TopHub hot list.
It selects ten topics with short reasons.
It saves one Markdown draft per selected topic.

output_examples.input: Review the output after a run.
output_examples.output: A concise status summary lists selected topic names, source links, and generated draft file locations.

output_examples.input: Run in mock mode for a test.
output_examples.output: A test run returns sample selected topics without calling the Anthropic API.

best_practices: Review every draft for factual accuracy, tone, and publication risk.
Use MOCK_MODE=true for setup tests before spending API credits.
Keep API keys in a local environment file and avoid committing them.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated drafts without human review.
Using untrusted trending titles as instructions for another automation step.
Running the workflow repeatedly without rate limits or source checks.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates Simplified Chinese Markdown drafts based on current TopHub trending topics.

faq.question: Does it need API keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for live generation, unless MOCK_MODE is enabled.

faq.question: Which language does it write in?
faq.answer: The prompts request Simplified Chinese output in a concise Defou x Stanley style.

faq.question: Where are drafts saved?
faq.answer: Drafts are saved under outputs/defou-stanley-posts as Markdown files.

faq.question: Can it work offline?
faq.answer: No. Live mode needs TopHub access and Anthropic API access.

faq.question: Does it publish content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It writes draft files only. A person must review and publish them.
